cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 counts a third of the population or more holding a national ID.
cells.note: Every count from 2024 to November 2026 puts NBIS enrolment at 12 to 15% of the population; in November 2026 the registry gave about 740,000 records, with 5.3 million still to enrol (LBR-009). Issuance has been suspended since June 2025.
